name: handoff-codex
description: Automatically monitors Codex conversation context and defers handoff until the current response finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Auto handoff for long Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Handoff Codex watches Codex Stop hook token usage, lets the current assistant response finish, then injects a handoff instruction on the next user prompt.
defaultPrompt: Use $handoff-codex to create a handoff for this session.
Explain how Handoff Codex will trigger handoffs.
